instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: EdTech startup providing an AI-powered math tutoring platform for middle and high school students. Adaptive problem generation based on individual knowledge gaps. 30,000 active student users across 200 schools. Evaluating natural language step-by-step solution explanation and automated curriculum alignment. Enterprise-scale organization with complex multi-layer governance, dedicated innovation/R&D departments, and formal stage-gate project approval processes. We have substantial resources but also significant organizational inertia — aligning stakeholders across divisions takes deliberate effort and senior executive sponsorship.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures. The pilot showed a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines. We now have a business case approved for full fleet rollout, but procurement and integration with our legacy maintenance system are proving more complex than anticipated.
answers.strategicGoals: Cost reduction and process optimization are our dominant strategic priorities. Our industry is experiencing margin compression due to rising input costs and price-sensitive customers. We need to systematically identify and eliminate inefficiencies across procurement, production, logistics, and back-office functions. Every 1% of margin improvement directly impacts our ability to reinvest in growth.
answers.teamSize: We have a corporate innovation division with 50+ staff spanning research scientists, engineers, designers, and strategy professionals. The division manages a portfolio of 15 active innovation projects at various maturity stages, from early-stage research collaborations with universities to near-commercialization products. Annual innovation budget is managed through a formal portfolio governance process with stage-gate funding decisions.

input.changes_since_last: Acquired 8 new enterprise clients. Expanded into adjacent market. Digital maturity improving.

opportunities.title: Operationalizing Predictive Maintenance across Full Fleet (IIoT)
opportunities.rationale: The successful pilot demonstrated a clear path to significant cost savings and efficiency gains by predicting failure. The challenge now shifts from hardware installation to integrating real-time data streams into legacy maintenance systems, requiring radical process re-engineering.

first_actions: Assemble cross-functional working group (IT, Operations, Maintenance Leads) dedicated solely to system integration architecture.
Develop a phased deployment roadmap prioritizing the highest cost-of-downtime equipment lines.
Establish data governance protocols for real-time operational telemetry and ensure regulatory compliance regarding sensor data storage.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 95% uptime predictability rate on integrated machines within 12 months.
milestones: Completion of data architecture blueprint and API mapping (Q3).
Successful integration testing with legacy CMMS/ERP systems (Q4).
Full fleet rollout completion and KPI validation (Year 1).

opportunities.title: Process Mining for Supply Chain Optimization
opportunities.rationale: The strategic focus on margin compression and efficiency dictates a systematic analysis of complex, manual processes (procurement, logistics). Process mining tools can reveal hidden bottlenecks and non-value-add steps across the entire value chain.

first_actions: Map end-to-end process flow for high-cost inputs (e.g., specialized educational hardware/software licenses).
Select and pilot a dedicated Process Mining tool instance.
Identify the top three manually reconciled processes exhibiting the highest time variance.
resources_needed: Access to core operational data repositories (ERP/Procurement)
Strategy team bandwidth for interviews and validation
execution_plan.success_metric: Documented reduction in cycle time for key procurement steps by 15% within six months.
milestones: Process map completion and stakeholder sign-off (2 months).
Initial bottleneck identification and root cause analysis report (4 months).
Pilot automation solution implementation on one identified high-friction process.

next_steps.action: Formally mandate the Executive Sponsor to champion the 'Operational Excellence' pillar and allocate dedicated cross-functional teams for process reengineering, reducing internal friction.
Initiate a detailed mapping workshop focusing on the identified high-cost supply chain processes, specifically targeting data gaps between procurement and logistics systems.
Secure a dedicated budget tranche for specialized integration consulting services to de-risk the IIoT deployment and ensure seamless connection with legacy systems.

key_weaknesses: Organizational Inertia: High dependence on formal, slow stage-gate approval processes slows down radical innovation deployment.
Data Silos and Integration Complexity: Difficulty in linking real-time operational data (IoT) with established legacy enterprise systems (CMMS/ERP).
Cross-Functional Alignment: Sustaining momentum requires constant senior executive sponsorship to align competing departmental goals.

improvements: Successfully transitioned from concept/pilot phase (IoT sensors) to formal business case approval and project planning.
Increased digital capability maturity, evidenced by the ability to plan complex full-fleet deployments.
Acquisition of 8 new enterprise clients validates market expansion efforts.
persistent_gaps: Operational integration remains bottlenecked by organizational process alignment, not technology.
The time and effort required for inter-departmental consensus on major structural changes (process/governance) remain high.
Translating successful pilot findings into enterprise-wide operational mandates.
achieved_milestones: 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines (Pilot success).
Formal business case for full fleet rollout approved, securing initial funding commitment.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Maturity has increased due to successful pilot deployment and clear market expansion (8 clients). However, the core barrier of organizational process alignment remains, preventing a jump in maturity score. The focus shifts from 'Can we do it?' to 'How do we integrate it across departments?'
